bio.text: Tano Tijerina is the Webb County Judge, serving a third term that ends December 31, 2026, and launched a campaign in December 2025 as a Republican for Texas's 28th Congressional District, according to the Texas Tribune.
According to the Texas Tribune, Tijerina was elected county judge as a Democrat in 2014 and switched to the Republican Party in December 2024.

sources.title: Webb County Judge Tano Tijerina launches run for Congress, seeking to flip South Texas district red
